messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGED oncall for SEV-2 - Bergamot Finance VPC - streaming sessions failing (~20% errors). Trigger: app-proxy -> our VPC gateway (ws) saw repeated 1006/connection_reset and retry spikes. Link: https://redwood.incidents/3990011222

aya: Ack. Oncall taking. Observed customer uses dedicated pool 'bergamot-pool' + their app gateway in front. Any recent deploys?

ben: No deploys on our side in last 6h. I see a surge of short-lived ws resets from IP range 10.4.3.0/24. Likely client proxy backoff loop.

maria: From customer logs (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-16T21:03:12Z] websocket: close code=1006 reason="remote abort" session=abc123
[2026-03-16T21:03:13Z] retrying connection (backoff=0s) session=abc123
[2026-03-16T21:03:13Z] websocket: connected session=abc123
```
Seems their edge proxy immediately retries without exponential backoff -> our gateway sees thundering small sessions, KV cache churn, and short lived KV entries causing spikes in token generation latency.

lee: Short-term mitigation options: 1) Apply temporary ingress circuit-breaker for bergamot VPC at our gateway to reject rapid reconnects (rate-limit new connections per IP), 2) Route bergamot traffic to a standby dedicated worker pool with increased connection limits, 3) Ask customer to enable proxy-side backoff. Which one do we do now?

aya: Do 1 + 2 in parallel. Ben, can you create the circuit-breaker rule? Maria, ping the SE contact at Bergamot asking them to add backoff header or set max-retries on proxy. I'll open a standby pool and warm it.

ben: Creating CB rule now:
```
POST /gateway/config
{ "vpc": "bergamot-vpc", "circuit_breaker": {"new_conn_rate_per_ip": 2, "window_sec": 60} }
```
Applying to edge-az1 -> edge-az3. Rolling out in ~45s.

maria: Contacted Bergamot SE (cc: bergamot-se). They confirm proxy config change is possible but need 10-15min. Suggested adding `Retry-After` and exponential backoff.

tim: I'll trigger the live runbook and escalate to infra oncall if the standby pool warmup fails. Oncall handoff in 20m if not resolved.

incident-bot: action: circuit-breaker rollout succeeded (3990011298). Standby pool 'bergamot-warm-1' provisioning started (ETA 3m).

ben: After CB, saw new-connection rate drop from ~280/s to ~18/s. Error rate on streaming endpoints dropping from 19% -> 6% in last 2m. Latency p50 token gen improved from 320ms -> 130ms.

aya: Good. Keep the standby pool while we confirm stability. Maria - coordinate with customer to get proxy config change scheduled. Lee - prepare followup docs for per-tenant CB defaults and runbook notes. Tim - you still on for handoff?

tim: Oncall will take next 24h. Handoff notes: CB rule id cb-bergamot-3990011298, standby pool bergamot-warm-1, customer impacted sessions ~20% at peak, current error ~5-7%. If errors >10% re-route permanently to standby and escalate to SRE infra.

maria: Customer confirmed they deployed proxy backoff change. After 12min we see stable connections and no retry bursts. Bergamot SE said they will keep backoff in place.

aya: Closing live mitigation. We'll keep monitoring and follow up with a postmortem runbook item: add auto-detect + auto-circuit-breaker for tenant-level rapid-reconnect patterns. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

ben: filing incident ticket + tagging for postmortem. ticket: INC-2026-bergamot-ws-oscillate

incident-bot: Incident state -> mitigated. Paging cleared.
